name: org.goldenphysics.aurocrypt/connect
title: Aurocrypt Connect
description: Aurocrypt Connect: AI access to your services, under approvals you set, without sharing passwords.

tools.name: vault_profile
tools.description: Return the stable API Vault profile represented by this authenticated connection. No provider credentials or internal owner identifiers are returned.

tools.name: vault_capabilities
tools.description: Describe API Vault's broker, autonomy modes, and credential boundary. Never returns stored credentials.

tools.name: vault_connections
tools.description: List API-key/PAT connections authorized to this connector. Safe metadata only; raw keys are never returned.

tools.name: vault_services
tools.description: List granular OAuth-connected service capabilities explicitly granted to this AI, including safe metadata for the user's bound repositories, projects, and other provider resources.

tools.name: vault_autonomy
tools.description: Show this AI's authority mode, provider-wide grants, user-owned connected resources, available provider surfaces (including dynamic Google API origins), and delegated browser profiles. Metadata only; no cookies, tokens, passwords, or provider secrets are returned.

tools.name: vault_models
tools.description: List AI models reachable through authorized API-key connections.

tools.name: vault_invoke_read
tools.description: Read data through an authorized API-key/PAT connection using a GET request. API Vault controls authentication and destination hosts and injects the stored credential server-side; credentials are never returned. Use vault_invoke_write for any operation that sends data or changes provider state.

connection_id.description: Identifier of the authorized API-key/PAT connection to use, from vault_connections.

operation.description: Operation name recorded for this request. Defaults to api.request.

path.description: Provider-relative request path, appended to the connection's controlled destination.

headers.description: Extra request headers as name/value pairs. Authentication is controlled by API Vault and cannot be set here.

credential.description: For owner-bound custom APIs only. API Vault chooses Bearer by default; set this only when the provider docs require a custom header or query parameter. The stored key is still injected server-side and never returned.

mode.description: How the stored credential is presented: a bearer Authorization header, a custom header, or a query parameter.

name.description: Header or query parameter name, required when mode is header or query.

scheme.description: Authentication scheme prefix for the credential value, when the provider requires one.

tools.name: vault_invoke_write
tools.description: Execute a provider operation through an authorized API-key/PAT connection using a POST request, including AI model calls. Authentication and destination hosts are controlled by API Vault; the stored credential is injected server-side and never returned.

connection_id.description: Identifier of the authorized API-key/PAT connection to use, from vault_connections.

operation.description: Operation name recorded for this request. Defaults to api.request.

path.description: Provider-relative request path, appended to the connection's controlled destination.

model_id.description: For AI model calls, the identifier of the model to invoke.

headers.description: Extra request headers as name/value pairs. Authentication is controlled by API Vault and cannot be set here.

credential.description: For owner-bound custom APIs only. API Vault chooses Bearer by default; set this only when the provider docs require a custom header or query parameter. The stored key is still injected server-side and never returned.

mode.description: How the stored credential is presented: a bearer Authorization header, a custom header, or a query parameter.

name.description: Header or query parameter name, required when mode is header or query.

scheme.description: Authentication scheme prefix for the credential value, when the provider requires one.

tools.name: vault_execute
tools.description: Execute one reviewed granular capability as the connected user, including approval-gated actions.

account_id.description: Identifier of the connected provider account, from vault_services or vault_autonomy.

capability_id.description: Identifier of the granular capability to execute, from vault_services.

params.description: Parameters for the capability, as defined by its schema in vault_services.

approval_id.description: Identifier of an owner approval already granted for this action, when the capability requires one.

tools.name: vault_provider_read
tools.description: Read data through a full-provider or owner-equivalent grant on a registered provider API surface using a GET request. API Vault pins or validates the destination origin, binds GitHub/Supabase requests to resources authorized by this user, and injects that user's OAuth credential server-side. For google.api.generic, supply the exact HTTPS Google API origin under *.googleapis.com. Use vault_provider_write for any operation that changes provider state.

account_id.description: Identifier of the connected provider account, from vault_services or vault_autonomy.

surface_id.description: Identifier of the registered provider API surface, from vault_autonomy.

origin.description: Required only for dynamic surfaces such as google.api.generic. Use an origin only (for example https://run.googleapis.com), never a path, query, credentials, or fragment.

path.description: Provider-relative path only; absolute and scheme-relative URLs are rejected.

headers.description: Extra request headers as name/value pairs. Authentication is controlled by API Vault and cannot be set here.

intent_lease_id.description: Optional active task-scoped Intent Lease. When supplied, it further narrows this provider action and consumes one lease action.

tools.name: vault_provider_write
tools.description: Change provider state through a full-provider or owner-equivalent grant on a registered provider API surface. API Vault pins or validates the destination origin, binds GitHub/Supabase requests to resources authorized by this user, injects that user's OAuth credential server-side, classifies risk, and enforces the owner's financial/security/destructive/communication switches. For google.api.generic, supply the exact HTTPS Google API origin under *.googleapis.com.

account_id.description: Identifier of the connected provider account, from vault_services or vault_autonomy.

surface_id.description: Identifier of the registered provider API surface, from vault_autonomy.

origin.description: Required only for dynamic surfaces such as google.api.generic. Use an origin only (for example https://run.googleapis.com), never a path, query, credentials, or fragment.

method.description: HTTP method for the provider request.

path.description: Provider-relative path only; absolute and scheme-relative URLs are rejected.

headers.description: Extra request headers as name/value pairs. Authentication is controlled by API Vault and cannot be set here.

risk_hint.description: Optional descriptive hint; it cannot lower server-classified risk.

intent_lease_id.description: Optional active task-scoped Intent Lease. When supplied, it further narrows this provider action and consumes one lease action.

tools.name: vault_browser_action
tools.description: Queue one structured action in a user-controlled authenticated browser profile. Browser cookies/session storage remain on the worker. Returns a job_id; call vault_browser_result until complete.

profile_id.description: Identifier of the delegated browser profile to act in, from vault_autonomy.

action.description: The browser action to queue in the profile.

type.description: The kind of browser action to perform.

origin.description: For fill_login only: the exact origin (scheme://host) to sign in to, for example https://github.com. A fill_login asks the owner-approved vault to sign in on that origin; you never supply or receive the credential. The job first waits for the owner to attach the login, then vault_browser_result returns one of signed_in, human_step_needed (passkey, captcha, or other_mfa), no_matching_login, or origin_not_bound.

selector.description: CSS selector identifying the element to act on.

text_selector.description: Visible text used to find the element when no selector is given.

role.description: ARIA role used to find the element to act on.

name.description: Accessible name used with role to find the element.

value.description: Value to type, select, or upload, depending on the action type.

key.description: Keyboard key to press, for press actions.

path.description: File path for download or upload actions.

clear.description: For type actions, clear the field before typing.

delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between steps, when supported.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the action to complete.

ms.description: Duration in milliseconds for wait actions.

wait_until.description: Page load state to wait for on navigate actions, such as load or networkidle.

full_page.description: For screenshot actions, capture the full page instead of the viewport.

human_approved.description: Set true only when the owner has approved this browser action in advance.

risk_hint.description: Optional descriptive hint; it cannot lower server-classified risk.

intent_lease_id.description: Optional active task-scoped Intent Lease. When supplied, it further narrows this browser action and consumes one lease action.

tools.name: vault_browser_result
tools.description: Read or consume the result of a previously queued API Vault browser job.

job_id.description: Identifier of the queued browser job, returned by vault_browser_action.

tools.name: vault_usage
tools.description: Read metadata-only API-key gateway usage for this connector.

limit.description: Maximum number of usage records to return.
